# OpenAI

## Overview
OpenAI is an AI research organization dedicated to ensuring that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

## Key Products
- **GPT Series**: GPT-3, GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo
- **ChatGPT**: Conversational AI assistant
- **API Platform**: Access to GPT models for developers
- **DALL-E**: Image generation model

## Technical Context
- Founded in 2015
- Based in San Francisco
- Transitioned from non-profit to capped-profit model
- Partnered with Microsoft for cloud infrastructure

## Relevance
User frequently interacts with OpenAI APIs for agent development projects.
